patterns.note: Immersive full-width image and video sections are used to establish brand aesthetic and showcase products in context, often with minimal overlay text.
Product listings are presented in a consistent four-column grid on desktop with minimal product information, emphasizing visual browsing.
Uppercase, sans-serif section headings are used to clearly delineate content blocks, maintaining a clean and modern aesthetic, contrasting with a decorative script for the hero text.
A high-contrast black and white base palette is consistently used for backgrounds and primary text, allowing vibrant product photography and a neon accent to provide the main bursts of color.

The primary navigation bar transforms from transparent over the hero to a solid white background with a subtle bottom gradient as the user scrolls past the initial hero section, becoming sticky at the top of the viewport.
Large, editorial-style photography sections are interspersed with product grids, creating a magazine-like browsing experience rather than a purely transactional one.

technique_notes: A full-bleed video hero section is used at the top of the page, overlaid with a decorative, glowing text element that appears to use CSS keyframes for its neon effect.
The main navigation bar is initially transparent and fixed, then transitions to a solid white background with a subtle bottom shadow and becomes sticky once the user scrolls past the hero section.
Product displays utilize a consistent grid layout with minimal text, relying on high-quality photography to convey product appeal.

design_tokens.type_scale: The hero text is very large and decorative (~4-5x body), while section headings are uppercase and moderately sized (~1.5x body). Body text and product details are standard and small respectively.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are consistently used throughout the design, particularly on product images and interactive elements.
design_tokens.spacing: The design features airy spacing in hero and large image sections, creating a sense of luxury, while product grids maintain a balanced density for efficient browsing.

standout: The site stands out with its sophisticated blend of high-end product photography and a minimalist, editorial layout, creating an experience akin to browsing an art gallery or design magazine. The distinctive neon 'Coming Soon' text over the hero video adds an unexpected, edgy touch to an otherwise refined aesthetic.
